# Lattice

## Overview

Many seats, one system. Four modular corners connect through a bright central unit. The regular grid makes contributions visible and gives the identity a precise, repeatable construction language.

VisualIdentity.md, Edition 1. This is a community proposal for IMD, not official branding. Tone: Precise, transparent and practical.

## Logo

![Lattice logomark](logomark.svg)

![IMD Lattice horizontal lockup](lockup.svg)

### Clear space and minimum size

Keep 12 units of the 64-unit mark clear on each side, equal to one outer tile. 16 CSS pixels for the mark alone; 128 CSS pixels for the horizontal lockup. Test the mark at its actual output size. Use the horizontal lockup when the name must be readable, and the mark alone in square avatars. Align to a layout edge, never against a container border.

### Color variations

Use the original full-color mark on a neutral surface. The supplied one-color version uses ink and negative space; the reversed version uses white and dark negative space. The original deployed mark is preserved exactly. Align applications to a square grid. Use the amber tiles as supporting geometry without treating them as interface status lights.

### Incorrect usage

Do not round tiles into circles, change tile spacing, replace the white center, skew the grid or add more tiles. Do not use the mark as a certification badge, endorsement or official IMD signature.

## Color

65% white, 20% ink, 10% amber and 5% supporting tints.

| Role | HEX | RGB |
| --- | --- | --- |
| primary 1 | #22223B | 34, 34, 59 |
| primary 2 | #F2A900 | 242, 169, 0 |
| secondary 1 | #CDCDE2 | 205, 205, 226 |
| secondary 2 | #FFE4A1 | 255, 228, 161 |
| neutral 1 | #FFFFFF | 255, 255, 255 |
| neutral 2 | #F3F3F7 | 243, 243, 247 |
| neutral 3 | #282833 | 40, 40, 51 |

### Accessible pairings

WCAG 2.2 AA normal text requires 4.5:1, and large text requires 3:1. Ratios below are calculated from sRGB relative luminance.

| Text | Background | Ratio | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| #22223B | #FFFFFF | 15.44:1 | Normal text |
| #FFFFFF | #22223B | 15.44:1 | Normal text |
| #22223B | #F2A900 | 7.68:1 | Normal text |

Tints and accents are for supporting geometry, not body text on white. Never use color alone for errors, selection or voting results. Pair color with a label.

## Typography

Display: **Space Mono**, weight 700, licensed under the SIL Open Font License. Text: **DM Sans**, weights 400 and 600, also OFL. Font licenses are included in the website fonts directory. Outlined wordmarks need no installed fonts.

Scale: 14, 16, 20, 28, 40 and 56 px. Body text starts at 16 px with a 1.6 line height. Headings use 1.1–1.2 and sentence case. Keep prose below 70 characters per line. Reserve the monospace display face for short titles and numeric labels; use DM Sans for paragraphs.

Web fallbacks: Space Mono, Courier New, monospace for display; DM Sans, system-ui, sans-serif for text. Host fonts locally, use WOFF2, and retain the font licenses.

## Applications

### Site header

Use the horizontal lockup at 128–180 px wide with the specified clear space. Keep navigation in DM Sans. Separate identity from transaction state: a brand accent never replaces an error message or a disabled control.

### Avatar

Center the mark in a square, keep clear space inside the crop, and inspect at 32 and 64 px. Use the original mark for community profiles and label the context as a proposal.

### Token icon

Use the mark alone, with enough padding to survive a circular crop. The 512 px PNG and favicon are ready for small contexts. Do not add price claims or verification marks.
